note: Election of the rural district council (five electoral divisions), 1946: nominations 20 September 1946 at Banbridge; no contest. There was no nomination for Laurelvale; the retiring member, deemed re-elected, is not named in the report read, so Laurelvale is not filed. Returned unopposed. Printed "Tandragee rural".
